title: DtoK3pi-pid-calib
summary: A physics research repository studying PID performance of the LHCb RICH detector via the D→K3pi decay channel, using Python and ROOT/C++ for BDT training, fits, and sWeights. Its synthetic-data experiment script instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer alongside other generators to compare synthetic tabular data generation methods.
